trade_economics.note: exits are not fixed TP/SL, so p* does not apply; mean net return per trade is compared with zero and the mean gross move with the round-trip cost

dsr.observations: OOS closed trades, net per-trade returns
dsr.sr0_critical_note: DSR stays >= threshold while E[max SR] of all trials, including unlogged ones, is below this (per-trade units)

caveats: Observations for DSR are OOS per-trade net returns (the equity curve is not persisted).
N counts logged trials only; choices made before logging (e.g. SMA50 chosen over 100/150/200 by the live script's author) are not in N, so N is a lower bound.
Fees, spread and slippage are the run's stated assumptions (real values UNKNOWN).
REPLAY results are research, not evidence of edge.
